Dominant Segments: Office workers; tourists; expats; downtown residents
Notable Communities: Greek Cypriot majority; large Russian/expat and tourist mix in the centre
Student University Proximity: CUT / TEPAK nearby; student presence but not the main ranging driver
Day Night Pattern: Office and tourist traffic all day; evening dining along the seafront
Dietary Considerations: Orthodox fasting (nisteia) in season; vegetarian/vegan emerging among expats
Product Recommendations: Tin/WAGMI beans; NOMAD sourdough; KEAN juices; PDO halloumi; Commandaria/zivania; laiki produce
Summary: Limassol Central (Leontiou) is the downtown premium store. Range specialty coffee, sourdough and a short local wine set. Family volume protein belongs in Limassol West and Agios Athanasios.

Notable Communities: Greek Cypriot majority; fewer short-stay tourists than the centre
Product Recommendations: Praskitiko halloumi; Polemidia produce; souvla meat; KEAN; trahana
Summary: Limassol West (Dilou) is the residential/west family store. Range village dairy and laiki produce. Do not copy Central's craft-coffee depth.

Notable Communities: Greek Cypriot majority; some expats in Mesa Geitonia / Agios Athanasios
Day Night Pattern: Weekday industrial/commute peaks; evening family cooking
Product Recommendations: Lefkonitziatis halloumi and yoghurt; Maroullas dairy; family meat; short Tin coffee set; everyday veg
Summary: Agios Athanasios (Iapetou industrial) has Lefkonitziatis on the doorstep. Lead with that factory dairy. This is suburban Limassol, not old town.

Dominant Segments: Civil servants; office workers; capital residents; some expats
Notable Communities: Greek Cypriot majority; smaller expat mix than Limassol centre
Student University Proximity: University of Cyprus is elsewhere in the city; not this immediate catchment
Dietary Considerations: Orthodox fasting in season; some vegetarian office demand
Product Recommendations: Pivo beer; Kollaborative/Utu beans; NOMAD sourdough; Constanza produce; halloumi; Tsiakkas zivania
Summary: Nicosia Central (Digeni Akrita) is the capital office-and-laiki store. Craft beer and specialty coffee belong here. Dali and Parissinos should not get the same premium set.

Notable Communities: Strong Greek Cypriot majority; fewer expats than central Nicosia
Day Night Pattern: Residential evenings; weekend souvla and laiki
Product Recommendations: Village halloumi; Dali produce; souvla meat; trahana; family bread
Summary: Dali is a south-Nicosia commuter town. WM lists the same warehouse address as Nicosia Central — still range it as its own catchment: village dairy and family protein, not capital specialty coffee.

Dominant Segments: Suburban Nicosia families; Strovolos / Archangelos residents
Notable Communities: Greek Cypriot majority; dense family suburb
Product Recommendations: Everyday halloumi and yoghurt; Strovolos veg; family meat; daily bread; KEAN juices
Summary: Parissinos (Archangelou Ave) is Strovolos family grocery. Volume dairy and weeknight cooking. Leave Pivo and Utu to Nicosia Central.

Dominant Segments: Local families; airport/tourism workers; summer visitors
Notable Communities: Greek Cypriot majority; tourist mix in summer; some expats
Day Night Pattern: Town daytime year-round; sharper summer evening demand
Product Recommendations: Zygi and Larnaca fish; Vouyiouklakis halloumi; citrus; KEAN; souvla meat
Summary: Larnaca Central (Thessalonikis Ave) should own seafood: Zygi landings plus the town fish market. Pair with Skarinou halloumi, not a Limassol coffee clone.

Dominant Segments: British holiday-home owners; tourists; west-coast residents
Notable Communities: British and Northern European holiday-home community; Greek Cypriot residents; summer visitors
Spending Profile: Mixed to premium in summer; mid-range off-season
Age Life Stage Skew: 50s-70s long-stay visitors; 30s-40s hospitality; families in summer
Day Night Pattern: Quiet winter residential; high summer old-town and Kato Paphos demand
Dietary Considerations: None dominant; British pantry comforts alongside Cypriot BBQ
Product Recommendations: Aphrodite's Rock beer; Beanhaus beans; Geroskipou loukoumi PGI; Vasilikon wine; halloumi for the grill; west-coast fruit
Summary: Paphos (Ellados Ave) is holiday-home plus old town. Range Geroskipou PGI sweets, Tsada craft beer and grilling halloumi. Winter ranging should shrink to residents.

Dominant Segments: Summer tourists; Paralimni families; free Famagusta-coast residents
Notable Communities: Greek Cypriot (including 1974 Famagusta displaced families); sharp summer visitor mix in Ayia Napa/Protaras
Spending Profile: Mixed to premium in summer; quieter mid-range off-season
Day Night Pattern: Quiet winter; very high summer daytime beach and BBQ demand
Product Recommendations: Day-boat fish; grilling halloumi; salad veg; KEAN and water; koupes and beach snacks
Summary: Ammochostos store is physically in Paralimni. Treat it as the east-coast summer engine with a local family base. Do not copy Paphos loukoumi or Nicosia craft beer as the lead.
